message: Hi, I'm a student with a python certification background. My overall academic average is 74.4% in an IT/computer-science degree. I'm interested in hacking and Business process analyst. I want to become a CRM Technical Developer. My family can afford at most about USD 2400 per year. I live in Kolkata. I'd strongly prefer to stay near home, though I might consider elsewhere in India. Getting a good job after graduation matters more to me than anything else.

other_constraints: Interested in hacking and Business process analyst roles

explanation:
This program in Hyderabad offers a strong median starting salary (USD 15400) and focuses on IT Management, which aligns well with your goal of becoming a CRM Technical Developer. The tuition (USD 1900) is also comfortably within your budget.

Located in Pune, this MTech program covers Computer Networks and Software Engineering, providing highly relevant technical skills for a developer role. It has a high starting salary (USD 15192) and the tuition is manageable within your budget.

This MCA in Coimbatore provides core software engineering skills and data science analytics, making it excellent for a technical developer role. The tuition is low (USD 1350), the placement rate is good, and it keeps you near home.

This program in Hyderabad focuses on QA Testing, which is a technical field that complements your interest in hacking/security. It offers a high placement rate (86%) and a good starting salary (USD 14917), while keeping you close to home.

Located in Coimbatore, this MSc program covers HCI and Software Engineering. It is budget-friendly (USD 2250) and provides a solid foundation in technical development while keeping you near your home city.
